facts: The **left whisker** (minimum to $Q_1$) holds the lowest $25\%$ of the data.
The **left half of the box** ($Q_1$ to the median) holds the next $25\%$, so the minimum to the median holds the lowest $50\%$.
The **right half of the box** (median to $Q_3$) holds the next $25\%$, so $Q_1$ to the maximum holds the highest $75\%$.
The **right whisker** ($Q_3$ to the maximum) holds the highest $25\%$.
To turn a proportion into a **count**, multiply it by the total number of data values.
steps: Locate the given score(s) among the five labelled features of the box plot.
Work out what proportion of the data lies in that region, using the $25\%$-per-region fact.
If a count is asked for, multiply that proportion by the total number of values.
